notes: Doubao reviews the rendered image and reports the problems it can see.
DeepSeek then turns that report plus the current layout into a concrete, layer-level edit plan: layout choice, product size and position, text size, spacing, per-layer nudges.
The app applies the plan, re-renders and re-submits, up to 4 rounds, and keeps the best-scoring version. Image 5 keeps its normal generation path - AI retouch is an explicit action.
Fixed a repeated-call failure: every AI request now carries a unique request id.
